name: Joint Entrance Examination (Advanced)
conducting_body: Joint Admission Board (JAB), constituted by IITs; administered by one IIT on rotation
scope: Gateway for admission to Bachelor's, Integrated Master's, and Dual Degree programmes in all IITs

paper1.type: Objective (MCQ, MSQ, numerical), designed to test comprehension, reasoning and analytical ability

paper2.type: Objective (MCQ, MSQ, numerical), designed to test comprehension, reasoning and analytical ability

papers.note: Both papers are compulsory. Questions may be multiple-choice, multiple-select, or numerical-answer type.

eligibility.primary_route: Candidates must be among the top 2,50,000 (approx.) successful candidates of JEE (Main) Paper 1, including all categories
eligibility.age_limit: Date of birth on or after 01 October 2001. Five-year relaxation for SC, ST, PwD candidates: on or after 01 October 1996.
eligibility.year_of_first_appearance_12th: Candidates should have appeared for the Class XII (or equivalent) examination for the first time in 2025 or 2026
eligibility.number_of_attempts: Maximum two attempts in consecutive years. A candidate can appear in JEE (Advanced) a maximum of two times (first appearance + one repeat), starting from the year they first appeared for Class XII/equivalent
eligibility.preparatory_courses: Candidates who qualified for the preparatory course in any of the IITs in 2025 can appear in JEE (Advanced) 2026
eligibility.oci_pio: OCI/PIO candidates who obtained their OCI/PIO cards before 04.03.2021 may choose either OCI/PIO (I) status, treated at par with Indian nationals, or OCI/PIO (F) status, treated as foreign nationals. OCI/PIO candidates who obtained their cards after 04.03.2021 are treated as OCI/PIO (F) and compete only for foreign supernumerary seats. OCI/PIO (I) and OCI/PIO (F) candidates are not entitled to reservation under GEN-EWS, OBC-NCL, SC, or ST categories.

registration_fee_inr_2026.note: Exact fee subject to annual revision; verify on jeeadv.ac.in at the time of registration.

schedule_2026.registration_window: To be announced (typically opens ~2 weeks after JEE Main Session 1 results)
schedule_2026.exam_date: To be announced (historically held on a Sunday in late May or early June)
schedule_2026.result_declaration: Typically within 2–3 weeks of the examination
schedule_2026.seat_allocation_start: Through JoSAA after JEE (Advanced) result; typically begins in mid-June

architecture_aptitude_test_aat.description: Candidates desiring admission to B.Arch. at IITs must qualify JEE (Advanced) AND appear in the Architecture Aptitude Test (AAT). It is NOT required for B.Tech. or other programmes.
architecture_aptitude_test_aat.eligibility: Only candidates who have qualified in JEE (Advanced) can register for AAT

schedule_2026.online_registration: Monday, June 01, 2026 (10:00 IST) to Tuesday, June 02, 2026 (17:00 IST)

tie_breaking_rules.description: If aggregate marks of two or more candidates are equal, the following tie-break policy applies in order:
steps: Step 1: Candidates with higher positive marks (total marks without negative marking) are awarded higher rank.
Step 2: If tie persists, higher marks in Mathematics breaks the tie.
Step 3: If tie still persists, higher marks in Physics breaks the tie.
Step 4: If tie still persists, candidates are assigned the same rank.

female_supernumerary_seats.description: Supernumerary seats created for female candidates to improve gender balance in IIT undergraduate programmes.
female_supernumerary_seats.eligibility: Only Indian nationals or OCI/PIO(I) candidates declared qualified in JEE (Advanced) 2026
female_supernumerary_seats.allocation: Strictly based on performance in JEE (Advanced) 2026
female_supernumerary_seats.target: Individual IITs ensure at least 20% female enrolment in undergraduate programme(s)
female_supernumerary_seats.implementation: Detailed procedure set out in JoSAA 2026 Business Rules
female_supernumerary_seats.note: No separate female supernumerary seats within foreign national supernumerary quota

foreign_nationals.description: Candidates who are NOT citizens of India (by birth or naturalized) are considered foreign nationals.
foreign_nationals.jee_main_requirement: NOT required to write JEE (Main) 2026; may register directly for JEE (Advanced) 2026 subject to other eligibility criteria
foreign_nationals.seats: Supernumerary with a cap of 10% of total number of seats in every course
foreign_nationals.reservation: Outside the ambit of GEN-EWS, OBC-NCL, SC, ST, and PwD reservation categories
foreign_nationals.female_supernumerary: No separate supernumerary seats or sub-category for females within foreign national quota

ranking.method: Aggregate marks in Paper 1 and Paper 2 across Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics. See `tie_breaking_rules` for tie resolution.
ranking.category_wise_ranking: Separate Common Rank Lists (CRLs) and category rank lists prepared for Gen-EWS, OBC-NCL, SC, ST, PwD

participating_institutes.note: See iit-list.json for the full list with locations.

contact.email: Typically published in the information brochure each year
contact.helpline: Published in the information brochure each year
